Check U3/U4 ADM3260: pin9 V_IN tied to +3V3. ADM3260 V_IN is the input supply for the isolated DC-DC converter. It should be connected to VDD_P? Actually ADM3260 has VDD_P (pin4) and V_IN (pin9). VDD_P is the primary side supply (3.3V or 5V). V_IN is the power input for the isoPower DC-DC converter. They are often tied together. OK.

Check U3/U4 pin13 VSEL: R20/R22 set VSEL. For ADM3260, VSEL pin selects V_ISO voltage. If VSEL tied to V_ISO? Actually VSEL is an input. The divider from V_ISO to GND sets the voltage. R20 16.9k from V_ISO to VSEL, R22 10k from VSEL to GND. That sets VSEL = V_ISO * 10/(16.9+10) = V_ISO * 0.372.
